title: Remote foundations O1: satellite enrollment/onboarding — operator steps plus an automated verification checklist that moves a satellite to 'verified'
outcome: Remote foundations O1: satellite enrollment/onboarding — operator steps plus an automated verification checklist that moves a satellite to 'verified'
acceptance: A documented onboarding flow separates the operator's own acts on the new host (SSH server, key, account; never performed by agents) from TermAl's enrollment (host_id, host-key fingerprint, pair capability exchange) recorded in the M1 registry.

An automated verification checklist runs reachability, host-key match, capability exchange, version/schema compatibility, a forward and reverse round trip over L1, wake delivery and a platform probe (OS/arch/toolchain); a satellite reaches 'verified' only when every check passes, and each failure is reported by name (tests with a fake satellite).
Adding a second or third satellite is configuration plus verification with no code change (a test enrolls two fake satellites).
Exact-input focused tests, the full five-stage gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

completion.summary: Delivered disabled-by-default satellite enrollment and explicit operator verification with nine named fenced checks, atomic enrollment/report proofs, recoverable durable isolated wakes, retained running-image identity and separate Engram results. Independent Codex/Claude carry and cleanup delta reviews leave no Medium-or-higher finding; independent acceptance 69b7b92972fc49c5bc336c1f7ac323bb passed all original four criteria.
